title: The B2Ne website
sub: How to look credible with nothing to show.
description: The B2Ne website: how a growth consultancy with one customer and no public presence set out to demonstrate credibility instead of claiming it. Words, structure and the Marketing Capacity Calculator by Riya Dutta.
facts: The words, the structure and the Marketing Capacity Calculator; the About, How We Help, Services, Pricing and Nexus Academy pages

hero.alt: The How We Help page on business2nexus.com

items.t: B2Ne needed a website. What it had was one customer, Nodinite, and no public presence at all: no site, no case studies, nothing a founder could find.
A growth firm that couldn’t show its own growth. Nobody hands their growth to a firm that looks like it’s still figuring things out.

sections.title: Stop claiming credibility. Demonstrate it.
sections.lead: One rule for every page: do something useful for a founder before they ever speak to us.

tiles.d: Founders at this stage rarely know which problem they have, so the site shows four milestones in order. A founder finds where they are and sees the next step.

tiles.t: A calculator where the pitch should be
tiles.d: The question under every first call is cost. The Marketing Capacity Calculator answers what B2Ne saves against hiring, before anyone has to ask.
With no proof to show, the site offers expertise instead: a free 360° audit on request, ten pages on performance, SEO, competitors and paid spend, built from GTmetrix, PageSpeed, Ahrefs and SpyFu.
